delivery.passExplainer: “Pass” ebe a pụtara naanị ihe nkesa lekwasịrị anya weghachiri ọkwa HTTP 2xx - ọ naghị akwado sistemụ nnabata echekwara ma ọ bụ hazie ụzọ ya. Lelee ahụ nzaghachi n'elu maka ihe o kwuru n'ezie; Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ oghere ma ọ bụ naanị nkwenye, usoro ahụ nwere ike ịnata arịrịọ ahụ mana ọ na-ajụ ma ọ bụ na-eleghara ụgwọ ọrụ n'ime ya (aha / usoro na-ezighị ezi maka API ya, mpaghara achọrọ n'akụkụ ya nke ụgwọ a anaghị agụnye, wdg).

push.title: Webhooks na-apụ apụ - Push edu & Mmelite
push.intro: Enwere ike ịhazi ya nke ọma kwa webhook : JSON , Ụdị (x-www-form-urlencoded), ma ọ bụ template ahụ gị nke nwere <fieldkey></fieldkey> ndị na-edobe ebe (dịka <example></example> )) - na-arụ ọrụ dị ka imejuputa iwu cURL otu ugboro.

push.curlHelp: Tapawa ihe atụ ịrịọ akwụkwọ API ha ma ọ bụ Postman na-enye gị (yana data n'ezie ma ọ bụ ihe nlele). The URL , usoro na nkụnye eji isi mee na-depụtaghachiri dị ka-dị, na ọ bụla igodo n'ime ahụ ka edepụtara n'okpuru ebe ị nwere ike họrọ nke CRM ubi jupụtara ya maka onye ọ bụla ndu.

api.title: API gị - Nweta ụzọ abụọ maka sistemụ ọ bụla
api.intro: Sistemu ọ bụla nwere igodo API gị nwere ike ịmepụta, gụọ na melite ụzọ yana denye aha na mmemme idu. Zipụ igodo na nkụnye eji isi mee <hdr></hdr> , dị ka <bearer></bearer> , ma ọ bụ (ọ bụrụ na ngwa ọrụ enweghị ike ịtọ nkụnye eji isi mee) dị ka <query></query> . Oke: {{limit}} arịrịọ kwa nkeji.

api.shownOnce: Detuo igodo a ugbu a ma chekwaa ya ebe nchekwa - maka nchekwa ọ na-egosi naanị otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ na ọ furu efu, mepụta nke ọhụrụ.
